overview: Clinical Data Query Resolution Assistant addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in pharma and life sciences operations. The first proof of value uses EDC entries, edit checks and site responses. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is open data queries per completed visit, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: open data queries per completed visit

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: EDC entries, edit checks and site responses; define open data queries per completed visit and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from Head of Quality / Clinical Operations Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
